tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Window background, active tab, header band, app icon tile. Theme.h `ground`. ink 11.3:1, inkSoft 6.3:1.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Recessed bands: tab bar, mixer and master sections, voice row, status bar, tracker column header. Theme.h `panel`. ink 9.6:1, inkSoft 5.3:1.

tokens.name: face
tokens.usage: Control faces and wells: buttons, readouts, knob caps, waveform and display wells. Theme.h `face`. ink 13.8:1, inkSoft 7.6:1.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: Tracker grid, order list and loop list background (Syre, Radio Looper). ink 12.0:1, inkSoft 6.6:1.

tokens.name: hilite
tokens.usage: Bevel highlight, top-left edge of raised controls; hover fill. Theme.h `hilite`.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Bevel shadow, bottom-right of raised controls and the top-left lip of wells. Theme.h `shadow`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text, 1px lines, knob pointers, and every on state: filled ink with ground text. Theme.h `ink`.

tokens.name: inkSoft
tokens.usage: Section labels, captions, secondary text, knob tick marks. Theme.h `inkSoft`. Readable on every surface.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Unfilled knob arcs, empty orders and empty tracker cells, disabled values. Theme.h `faint`. 1.7:1 on sheet, so only for placeholders that carry no information.

tokens.name: onInk
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on an ink fill (pressed buttons, selected segments, edit cursor). Same value as ground. 11.3:1.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Text on clay (4.8:1) and plum (8.1:1) track fills.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Graph-paper grid every 8px in wells, cell rules. Theme.h `rule`.

tokens.name: ruleMajor
tokens.usage: Graph-paper grid every 40px in display wells.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Divider between control rows inside a panel. Section boundaries use ink.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Track or channel 1. Syre Osc A. Text on it in paper.

tokens.name: khaki
tokens.usage: Track or channel 2, the lightest track colour. Text on it in ink (6.8:1).

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Track or channel 3. Syre Osc B. Text on it in ink (5.6:1).

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Track or channel 4, the darkest. Syre's tracker. Text on it in paper.

tokens.name: rec
tokens.usage: Record only: the Rec dot, Rec on, the edit LED, and the meter's over-0 dB zone. Never text on ground (3.7:1). Theme.h `rec`.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Block selection background in tracker grids. ink 7.9:1.

tokens.name: selectionFaint
tokens.usage: Empty-cell placeholders inside a selected block.

tokens.name: playingFaint
tokens.usage: Empty-cell placeholders inside the playing row (3.9:1 on cat-plum).

tokens.name: rowBeat
tokens.usage: Tracker row background every 4 rows.

tokens.name: rowBar
tokens.usage: Tracker row background every 16 rows.

tokens.name: hatchInk
tokens.usage: Hatch on invalid values, such as an out-of-range tracker effect (135deg, 1px line, 5px pitch).

tokens.name: hatch
tokens.usage: Diagonal hatch for muted channels and disabled controls (135deg, 1px line, 7px pitch). RR: muted is hatched.

tokens.name: chargeOff
tokens.usage: Unlit segments in segment meters such as Syre's accent charge.

tokens.name: cursor
tokens.usage: Edit cursor cell fill when edit mode is on; 1px outline ring when off.

tokens.name: playing
tokens.usage: Row or slot currently playing, follows playback. Defaults to plum; inside a channel, use that channel's colour.

tokens.name: automated
tokens.usage: Knob value ring and AUTO tag when the host automates the parameter.

tokens.name: trackerDriven
tokens.usage: Knob value ring and TRK tag when a tracker effect drives the parameter.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Product name in the header band (Syre 32px, RR 34px), with the 4-colour bar under it.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Track, channel and section names: Track 1, Osc A, Master. 22 to 28px.

styles.name: tracker-cell
styles.usage: Note, accent and effect cells in the pattern grid.

styles.name: tracker-row
styles.usage: Row numbers and order list entries.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Numeric readouts: tempo, speed, pattern, master dB.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Button and segment labels, knob values. Uppercase.

styles.name: label-small
styles.usage: Field captions above readouts, FIG. numbers. Uppercase.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: AUTO and TRK tags on knobs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Caption-to-readout gap, meter bar gap, accent charge segment gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label-to-knob gap, padding above a control row after a rule-soft divider.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a section header and its content; label-to-rule gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between oscillator slots, window gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Tracker column gap, header band item gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between knobs in a row, between sections in the lower row.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Tracker row and order list row height.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Segmented switch, readout, file loader and small button height.

tokens.name: size-panel-head
tokens.usage: Slot and track header band, status bar height.

tokens.name: size-transport
tokens.usage: Transport and header button height; transport button width is 44px.

tokens.name: size-header
tokens.usage: Top header band height.

tokens.name: size-knob
tokens.usage: Main rotary knob, with 11 tick marks outside the ring.

tokens.name: size-knob-mid
tokens.usage: Rotary knob in oscillator slots and overdrive, no ticks.

tokens.name: size-knob-small
tokens.usage: Inline small knob with label left and value right.

tokens.name: size-readout-wide
tokens.usage: Minimum width for a slider's value text box.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything rectangular: panels, buttons, wells, cells.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Knob caps and the edit LED only.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Raised controls (Platinum bevel): buttons, stepper arrows, slider thumb. Pressed or on loses it.

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: Wells: readouts, number fields, meters, waveform, tracker grid, order list.

tokens.name: cursorRing
tokens.usage: Tracker cursor cell when edit mode is off; invalid effect cell.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Every outline and section rule.

tokens.name: stroke-wave
tokens.usage: Waveform and filter curve lines.

tokens.name: stroke-ring
tokens.usage: Knob value ring at 40px and up; 2px on the 24px small knob.
